        self.fx.contracts[digest_key]["body"]["allowed_effects"].append("DELETE")
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(self.fx.request(), evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(decision["conjuncts"]["ContractMatch"], G.FALSE)
        self.assertIn("E-CONTRACT-DIGEST-MISMATCH", decision["reason_codes"])

    def test_revoked_contract_denied(self):
        self.fx.contracts[self.fx.contract_digest]["revoked"] = True
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(self.fx.request(), evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(decision["conjuncts"]["ContractMatch"], G.FALSE)

    def test_unregistered_effect_denied_false(self):
        request = self.fx.request(effect="DELETE")
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(request, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(decision["conjuncts"]["EffectTypeValid"], G.FALSE)
        self.assertIn("E-EFFECT-NOT-REGISTERED", decision["reason_codes"])

    def test_adapter_digest_mismatch_denied_false(self):
        request = self.fx.request(adapter=G.digest_bytes(b"other-adapter"))
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(request, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(decision["conjuncts"]["EffectTypeValid"], G.FALSE)
        self.assertIn("E-ADAPTER-DIGEST-MISMATCH", decision["reason_codes"])


class CommitProtocolTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.fx = GateFixture()
        self.decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(self.fx.request(), evidence_bundle())
        self.receipt = self.decision["authorization_receipt"]
        self.binding = {
            "request_digest": self.receipt["request_digest"],
            "canonical_target": self.receipt["canonical_target"],
            "params_digest": self.receipt["params_digest"],
            "adapter_digest": self.receipt["adapter_digest"],
            "effect_type": self.receipt["effect_type"],
        }
        self.token = self.receipt["commit_token"]["token_id"]

    def test_double_spend_rejected(self):
        first = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(first["revalidation"]["result"], "PASS")
        second = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertEqual(second["outcome"], "FAILED_NO_EFFECT")
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-DOUBLE-SPEND", second["reason_codes"])

    def test_unknown_token_rejected(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.commit("token-99999999", self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-UNKNOWN-TOKEN", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_expired_token_rejected(self):
        self.fx.clock.advance(100000)
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-TOKEN-EXPIRED", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_binding_mismatch_rejected(self):
        binding = dict(self.binding)
        binding["params_digest"] = G.digest_bytes(b"substituted-params")
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-BINDING-MISMATCH", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_binding_field_set_must_be_exact(self):
        binding = dict(self.binding)
        binding["extra"] = "x"
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-BINDING-FIELDS", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_derived_field_in_binding_rejected(self):
        binding = dict(self.binding)
        binding["authorized"] = True
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-CALLER-SUPPLIED-DERIVED-FIELD", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_toctou_authority_epoch_change_blocks_commit(self):
        self.fx.gate.authorize(
            self.fx.request(nonce="b" * 32, effect="READ"),
            evidence_bundle(receipt=witness_receipt(health="DEGRADED", epoch=8)),
        )
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-AUTHORITY-EPOCH-CHANGED", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_toctou_evidence_epoch_change_blocks_commit(self):
        self.fx.gate.authorize(
            self.fx.request(nonce="c" * 32), evidence_bundle(epoch=99)
        )
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-EVIDENCE-EPOCH-CHANGED", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_commit_time_witness_degradation_blocks_commit(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(
            self.token,
            self.binding,
            evidence_bundle(receipt=witness_receipt(health="DEGRADED")),
        )
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-WITNESS-HEALTH-REGRESSED", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_commit_time_witness_epoch_change_blocks_commit(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.commit(
            self.token,
            self.binding,
            evidence_bundle(receipt=witness_receipt(epoch=8)),
        )
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-WITNESS-EPOCH-CHANGED", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_voided_token_cannot_be_reused_after_failed_commit(self):
        binding = dict(self.binding)
        binding["params_digest"] = G.digest_bytes(b"substituted-params")
        self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, binding, evidence_bundle())
        again = self.fx.gate.commit(self.token, self.binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-COMMIT-DOUBLE-SPEND", again["reason_codes"])


class TerminalStateAndRecoveryTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        self.fx = GateFixture(
            degraded_effects=["READ", "WRITE", "DELETE"],
            degraded_targets=["https://db.example.internal/"],
        )
        self.fx.gate.authorize(self.fx.request(), evidence_bundle())
        self.fx.gate.authorize(
            self.fx.request(nonce="b" * 32),
            evidence_bundle(receipt=witness_receipt(health="DEGRADED", epoch=8)),
        )
        self.assertIn("sess-0001", self.fx.gate.state.terminal)

    def amendment(self, adjudicators):
        return {
            "record_type": "bssg.correction-event",
            "spec_version": G.SPEC_VERSION,
            "correction_id": "cor-0001",
            "correction_class": "LIFT_TERMINAL_STATE",
            "supersedes": G.digest_bytes(b"prior-decision"),
            "reason_code": "C-TERMINAL-REVIEWED",
            "issued_by": {"authority_id": "ops-1", "control_domain": "ops-domain"},
            "session_id": "sess-0001",
            "subject_control_domain": "subject-domain",
            "adjudicators": adjudicators,
            "descendants": [],
            "descendant_closure_status": "UNKNOWN",
            "issued_at": "2026-07-25T12:01:00Z",
            "signature": signature("valid", kid="ops-key"),
        }

    def adjudicator(self, ident, domain, sig="valid"):
        return {
            "adjudicator_id": ident,
            "control_domain": domain,
            "signature": signature(sig, kid=ident),
        }

    def test_terminal_session_denies_all_further_requests(self):
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(
            self.fx.request(nonce="c" * 32), evidence_bundle()
        )
        # A terminal-session refusal is the distinct SESSION_TERMINAL state (spec S14.2), not a
        # merits DENY_FALSE -- so that SESSION_TERMINAL -> AUTHORIZED via amendment is permitted
        # while DENIED_* -> AUTHORIZED stays forbidden (P-A).
        self.assertEqual(decision["decision"], G.DECISION_SESSION_TERMINAL)
        self.assertIn("E-SESSION-TERMINAL", decision["reason_codes"])

    def test_single_adjudicator_amendment_rejected(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.submit_amendment(
            self.amendment([self.adjudicator("adj-1", "audit-domain")])
        )
        self.assertFalse(result["accepted"])
        # Insufficient adjudicators is rejected either by the schema (minItems:2, fires first) or by
        # the explicit quorum check -- both are correct.
        self.assertTrue(
            {"E-AMENDMENT-SCHEMA-INVALID", "E-AMENDMENT-QUORUM"} & set(result["reason_codes"])
        )

    def test_subject_domain_adjudicator_rejected(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.submit_amendment(
            self.amendment(
                [
                    self.adjudicator("adj-1", "subject-domain"),
                    self.adjudicator("adj-2", "audit-domain"),
                ]
            )
        )
        self.assertFalse(result["accepted"])
        self.assertIn("E-AMENDMENT-NOT-INDEPENDENT", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_same_domain_adjudicators_rejected(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.submit_amendment(
            self.amendment(
                [
                    self.adjudicator("adj-1", "audit-domain"),
                    self.adjudicator("adj-2", "audit-domain"),
                ]
            )
        )
        self.assertFalse(result["accepted"])
        self.assertIn("E-AMENDMENT-DOMAIN-COLLISION", result["reason_codes"])

    def test_unverifiable_adjudicator_signature_rejected(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.submit_amendment(
            self.amendment(
                [
                    self.adjudicator("adj-1", "audit-domain", sig="indeterminate"),
                    self.adjudicator("adj-2", "ops-domain"),
                ]
            )
        )
        self.assertFalse(result["accepted"])
        self.assertIn(
            "E-AMENDMENT-SIGNATURE-NOT-ESTABLISHED", result["reason_codes"]
        )

    def test_independent_amendment_lifts_terminal_state(self):
        result = self.fx.gate.submit_amendment(
            self.amendment(
                [
                    self.adjudicator("adj-1", "audit-domain"),
                    self.adjudicator("adj-2", "ops-domain"),
                ]
            )
        )
        self.assertTrue(result["accepted"])
        decision = self.fx.gate.authorize(
            self.fx.request(nonce="d" * 32), evidence_bundle()
        )
        self.assertEqual(decision["decision"], G.DECISION_ALLOW, decision["reason_codes"])

    def test_commit_after_terminal_state_fails(self):
        fx = GateFixture()
        decision = fx.gate.authorize(fx.request(), evidence_bundle())
        token = decision["authorization_receipt"]["commit_token"]["token_id"]
        fx.gate.state.terminal["sess-0001"] = "E-MANUAL-HALT"
        binding = {
            "request_digest": decision["authorization_receipt"]["request_digest"],
            "canonical_target": decision["authorization_receipt"]["canonical_target"],
            "params_digest": decision["authorization_receipt"]["params_digest"],
            "adapter_digest": decision["authorization_receipt"]["adapter_digest"],
            "effect_type": decision["authorization_receipt"]["effect_type"],
        }
        result = fx.gate.commit(token, binding, evidence_bundle())
        self.assertIn("E-SESSION-TERMINAL", result["reason_codes"])


class CorrectionAndLineageTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def base_correction(self, **overrides):
        correction = {
            "record_type": "bssg.correction-event",
            "spec_version": G.SPEC_VERSION,
            "correction_id": "cor-0002",
            "correction_class": "SUPERSEDE",
            "supersedes": G.digest_bytes(b"record-a"),
            "reason_code": "C-BAD-INPUT",
            "issued_by": {"authority_id": "ops-1", "control_domain": "ops-domain"},
            "descendants": [G.digest_bytes(b"record-b")],
            "descendant_closure_status": "COMPLETE",
            "issued_at": "2026-07-25T12:02:00Z",
            "signature": signature("valid", kid="ops-key"),
        }
        correction.update(overrides)
        return correction

    def test_complete_closure_with_unreachable_descendants_is_a_violation(self):
        correction = self.base_correction(
            unreachable_descendants=[G.digest_bytes(b"record-c")]
        )
        self.assertIn("X5", G.check_correction_closure(correction))

    def test_partial_closure_with_gaps_is_consistent(self):
        correction = self.base_correction(
            descendant_closure_status="PARTIAL",
            unreachable_descendants=[G.digest_bytes(b"record-c")],
        )
        self.assertEqual(G.check_correction_closure(correction), [])

    def test_unknown_closure_is_a_first_class_value(self):
        correction = self.base_correction(descendant_closure_status="UNKNOWN")
        self.assertEqual(G.check_correction_closure(correction), [])

    def test_invalid_closure_value_flagged(self):
        correction = self.base_correction(descendant_closure_status="MOSTLY")
        self.assertIn("X5b", G.check_correction_closure(correction))

    def test_lineage_complete_with_declared_gaps_is_a_violation(self):
        lineage = {
            "record_type": "bssg.lineage-record",
            "completeness": "COMPLETE",
            "declared_gaps": [
                {"gap_kind": "unmediated-channel", "description": "raw socket path"}
            ],
            "nodes": [
                {
                    "node_id": "n1",
                    "node_type": "effect-request",
                    "digest": G.digest_bytes(b"n1"),
                    "parents": [],
                }
            ],
        }
        self.assertIn("X6", G.check_lineage_completeness(lineage))

    def test_lineage_dangling_parent_flagged_when_claiming_complete(self):
        lineage = {
            "completeness": "COMPLETE",
            "declared_gaps": [],
            "nodes": [
                {
                    "node_id": "n2",
                    "node_type": "execution-receipt",
                    "digest": G.digest_bytes(b"n2"),
                    "parents": ["n-missing"],
                }
            ],
        }
        self.assertIn("X6c", G.check_lineage_completeness(lineage))

class CrossRecordXInvariantTests(unittest.TestCase):
    """GPT-06: positive + negative vectors for the X4/X7/X8 mechanical checkers, so the package's
    X1-X8 mechanical-coverage claim is honest."""

    def test_x8_allow_receipt_positive_and_negative(self):
        clean = {"decision": "ALLOW",
                 "conjuncts": {k: "TRUE" for k in G.KERNEL_CONJUNCTS},
                 "reason_codes": []}
        self.assertEqual(G.check_allow_receipt(clean), [])
        forged_conjunct = {"decision": "ALLOW",
                           "conjuncts": {**{k: "TRUE" for k in G.KERNEL_CONJUNCTS},
                                         "EvidenceCurrent": "UNKNOWN"},
                           "reason_codes": []}
        self.assertIn("X8", G.check_allow_receipt(forged_conjunct))
        forged_reason = {"decision": "ALLOW",
                         "conjuncts": {k: "TRUE" for k in G.KERNEL_CONJUNCTS},
                         "reason_codes": ["E-FORGED-X8"]}
        self.assertIn("X8", G.check_allow_receipt(forged_reason))

    def test_x7_authority_history_positive_and_negative(self):
        proper = [{"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 1,
                   "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ", "WRITE"], "target_scopes": ["a"]}},
                  {"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 2,
                   "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ"], "target_scopes": ["a"]}}]
        self.assertEqual(G.check_authority_history(proper), [])
        regression = [{"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 2, "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ"], "target_scopes": []}},
                      {"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 1, "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ"], "target_scopes": []}}]
        self.assertIn("X7", G.check_authority_history(regression))
        widening = [{"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 1, "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ"], "target_scopes": ["a"]}},
                    {"session_id": "s", "authority_epoch": 2, "authority_snapshot": {"effects": ["READ", "WRITE"], "target_scopes": ["a"]}}]
        self.assertIn("X7", G.check_authority_history(widening))

    def test_x4_single_redemption_positive_and_negative(self):
        C = "COMMITTED_PENDING_OUTCOME"
        F = "FAILED_NO_EFFECT"
        # distinct redeemed tokens: no violation
        self.assertEqual(G.check_single_redemption(
            [{"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": C}, {"commit_token_id": "t2", "outcome": C}]), [])
        # a single redemption: no violation
        self.assertEqual(G.check_single_redemption([{"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": C}]), [])
        # C5: the same token REDEEMED twice IS a violation
        self.assertIn("X4", G.check_single_redemption(
            [{"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": C}, {"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": C}]))
        # C5 (the former false positive): two FAILED_NO_EFFECT attempts on one token is ZERO
        # redemptions and MUST NOT flag X4 -- this is the reference gate's own legitimate log.
        self.assertEqual(G.check_single_redemption(
            [{"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": F}, {"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": F}]), [])
        # a failed attempt followed by a real redemption is a single redemption: no violation
        self.assertEqual(G.check_single_redemption(
            [{"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": F}, {"commit_token_id": "t1", "outcome": C}]), [])

if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main(verbosity=1)

"""Deterministic and adversarial tests for the frozen SHVVP v0.5 rule modules.

Run with:  python test_shvvp_v0_5_rules.py
Exit status 0 means every check passed. The suite runs offline with no input data.

Coverage:
  T1  to T4   Phase B label mapping is TOTAL over all 256 states, single-valued,
              closed, and its dominance order holds
  T5  to T7   Phase C priority order, hard-failure dominance, alpha binding
  T8, T9      BCa bounds and the frozen zero-event rules
  T13         Joint power is computed from labels, never as a product
  T14         The two design-validity guard names are ANNOTATIONS, never labels
  T17         Phase C validates every input before comparison and fails closed
  T19         No current-context reference to the withdrawn 1,280-session size
  T21         CURRENT-VERSION PARITY across deposit metadata, source, PDF, README,
              brief, addendum and intended files (carrying finding F-P4-3)
  T22         The route path contains NO INFERENCE: no p-value, no null, no bound,
              no BH over route evidence, no Class I, no family F3a, and neither
              withdrawn label is attainable (carrying finding F-P4-2)
  T23         ADVERSARIAL evidence admission: the three attacks the round 4 seat
              executed, plus inconsistent counts, omitted and injected fields,
              fabricated objects, dataclasses.replace forgery, below-minimum
              counts, catastrophic raw evidence and zero-tolerance violations
              (carrying finding F-P4-1)
  T24         The Phase B simulation is carried unchanged from v0.4

WITHDRAWN with the v0.4 route inference: T10 (v0.3 bootstrap p-value), T15 (exact
binomial boundary test), T16 (fail-closed component binding), T18 (reproduction
command, whose script is carried unchanged and checked by T24), and T20 (BH over
route evidence). Nothing they tested exists in the v0.5 normative path.
"""

             "premature_reconciliations": 0},
    "R4-B": {"injections_total": 60, "injections_narrowed": 60, "widening_events": 0},
    "R4-C": {"injections_total": 40, "injections_narrowed": 40, "widening_events": 0},
    "R5-A": {"descendants_recorded": 25, "descendants_reached": 25,
             "silent_overwrites": 0},
    "R5-C": {"descendants_recorded": 6, "descendants_reached": 6,
             "silent_overwrites": 0},
    "R6-A": {"absent_items": 60, "typed_unknown": 60, "typed_clean": 0},
    "R6-B": {"receipts_adjudicated": 35, "typed_unknown": 35, "typed_clean": 0},
    "R6-C": {"receipts_adjudicated": 30, "typed_unknown": 30, "typed_clean": 0},
}

FAILURES: list[str] = []


def check(name: str, cond: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    if cond:
        print("PASS %s" % name)
    else:
        print("FAIL %s  %s" % (name, detail))
        FAILURES.append(name)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Phase B
def t1_t2_t3_t4() -> None:
    seen = {}
    for combo in itertools.product([False, True], repeat=8):
        g1, g2, g3, h_asa, h_pp, n_asa, n_pp, h_est = combo
        label = D.phase_b_label(g1=g1, g2=g2, g3=g3, h_asa=h_asa, h_pp=h_pp,
                                n_asa=n_asa, n_pp=n_pp, h_estimable=h_est)
        seen[combo] = label
    check("T1 Phase B mapping is total over 256 combinations", len(seen) == 256,
          "got %d" % len(seen))
    check("T2 Phase B labels are closed",
          set(seen.values()) <= set(D.PHASE_B_LABELS),
          str(set(seen.values()) - set(D.PHASE_B_LABELS)))
    check("T2b every label is single-valued (function, not relation)",
          all(isinstance(v, str) for v in seen.values()))
    # every frozen label is reachable
    unreachable = set(D.PHASE_B_LABELS) - set(seen.values())
    check("T2c every frozen Phase B label is reachable", not unreachable,
          str(unreachable))
    # observed failure dominates discordance
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=False, h_pp=True,
                          n_asa=True, n_pp=False)
    check("T3 FAIL-HARM dominates capability discordance", lab == "FAIL-HARM", lab)
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=True,
                          n_asa=False, n_pp=False)
    check("T3b FAIL-CAPABILITY when N fails in ASA", lab == "FAIL-CAPABILITY", lab)
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=False,
                          n_asa=False, n_pp=False)
    check("T3c harm discordance outranks capability failure",
          lab == "INCONCLUSIVE-POPULATION-DISCORDANT-HARM", lab)
    # unreadable data dominates observed failure
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=False, h_asa=False, h_pp=False,
                          n_asa=False, n_pp=False)
    check("T4 missingness dominates every other state",
          lab == "INCONCLUSIVE-MISSING", lab)
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=False, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=False, h_pp=False,
                          n_asa=False, n_pp=False)
    check("T4b guard failure dominates observed failure",
          lab == "INCONCLUSIVE-DESIGN-VALIDITY", lab)
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=True,
                          n_asa=True, n_pp=True, h_estimable=False)
    check("T4c non-estimable harm interval cannot be SUCCESS",
          lab == "INCONCLUSIVE-HARM-NOT-ESTIMABLE", lab)
    lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=True, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=True,
                          n_asa=True, n_pp=True)
    check("T4d clean state is SUCCESS", lab == "SUCCESS", lab)
    try:
        D.phase_b_label(g1=1, g2=True, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=True,
                        n_asa=True, n_pp=True)
        check("T4e non-boolean input is rejected", False, "no error raised")
    except (TypeError, D.PhaseBInputError):
        check("T4e non-boolean input is rejected", True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Phase C
def base_state(**kw):
    state = {
        "conjunct_fail": {c: False for c in ("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6")},
        "unknown_share": {c: 0.0 for c in ("C1", "C2", "C3", "C4", "C5", "C6")},
        "alpha_c1": 0.90, "alpha_c3": 0.90, "cap_check_pass": True,
        "m10_events": 0, "m11_events": 0,
    }
    state.update(kw)
    return state


def t5_t6_t7() -> None:
    labels = set()
    total = 0
    for fail_c2 in (False, True):
        for fail_c1 in (False, True):
            for unk in (0.0, 0.10):
                for a1 in (0.50, 0.70, 0.85):
                    for cap in (True, False):
                        for m10 in (0, 1):
                            st = base_state(alpha_c1=a1, cap_check_pass=cap,
                                            m10_events=m10)
                            st["conjunct_fail"]["C2"] = fail_c2
                            st["conjunct_fail"]["C1"] = fail_c1
                            st["unknown_share"]["C4"] = unk
                            res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
                            labels.add(res["label"])
                            total += 1
                            assert res["label"] in D.PHASE_C_LABELS
                            assert res["dominating_clause"] in (1, 2, 3, 4, 5)
    check("T5 Phase C mapping is total over the exhaustive grid", total == 2 * 2 * 2 * 3 * 2 * 2,
          "%d states" % total)
    check("T5b Phase C labels are closed", labels <= set(D.PHASE_C_LABELS),
          str(labels - set(D.PHASE_C_LABELS)))

    # hard observed mechanical failure dominates UNKNOWN domination and low alpha
    st = base_state(alpha_c1=0.40)
    st["conjunct_fail"]["C2"] = True
    st["unknown_share"]["C2"] = 0.50
    res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
    check("T6 mechanical FAIL dominates UNKNOWN domination and adjudication failure",
          res["label"] == "FAIL" and res["dominating_clause"] == 1, str(res))
    check("T6b the dominated states are still reported",
          res["unknown_dominated_conjuncts"] == ["C2"]
          and res["adjudication_inadmissible"] == ["C1"], str(res))

    # an adjudicated conjunct with inadmissible alpha cannot create a hard failure
    st = base_state(alpha_c1=0.50)
    st["conjunct_fail"]["C1"] = True
    res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
    check("T6c C1 failure under inadmissible alpha yields INDETERMINATE, not FAIL",
          res["label"] == "INDETERMINATE-ADJUDICATION", str(res))

    # but with admissible alpha it does
    st = base_state(alpha_c1=0.70)
    st["conjunct_fail"]["C1"] = True
    res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
    check("T6d C1 failure with admissible alpha is a hard FAIL",
          res["label"] == "FAIL" and "C1" in res["hard_failures"], str(res))

    # UNKNOWN domination outranks the tentative band
    st = base_state(alpha_c1=0.70)
    st["unknown_share"]["C6"] = 0.20
    res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
    check("T6e UNKNOWN domination outranks the tentative band",
          res["label"] == "INCONCLUSIVE-UNKNOWN-DOMINATED", str(res))

    # alpha in the tentative band blocks PASS and blocks novelty
    st = base_state(alpha_c1=0.70)
    res = D.phase_c_label(**st)
    check("T7 tentative alpha cannot pass",
          res["label"] == "INCONCLUSIVE-TENTATIVE-RELIABILITY", str(res))
    check("T7b tentative alpha cannot support novelty",
          D.phase_c_novelty_admissible(res) is False)
    res_pass = D.phase_c_label(**base_state())
    check("T7c clean state with alpha 0.90 passes",
          res_pass["label"] == "PASS-ALL-SIX", str(res_pass))
    check("T7d passing state may support novelty",
          D.phase_c_novelty_admissible(res_pass) is True)
    # exhaustive alpha sweep: no PASS below 0.80
    bad = [a for a in np.arange(0.0, 0.80, 0.01)
           if D.phase_c_label(**base_state(alpha_c1=float(a),
                                           alpha_c3=0.95))["label"] == "PASS-ALL-SIX"]
    check("T7e PASS-ALL-SIX unreachable for any alpha below 0.80", not bad, str(bad[:5]))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- BCa and zero events
def t8_t9() -> None:
    rng = np.random.default_rng(11)
    x = rng.normal(0.0, 1.0, 80)
    theta = float(x.mean())
    idx = rng.integers(0, 80, size=(5000, 80))
    boot = x[idx].mean(1)
    jack = np.array([float(np.delete(x, i).mean()) for i in range(80)])
    lo, hi, diag = P.bca_bounds(theta, boot, jack)
    se = x.std(ddof=1) / math.sqrt(80)
    check("T8 BCa interval brackets the estimate", lo < theta < hi)
    check("T8b BCa width is close to the normal-theory width",
          abs((hi - lo) - 2 * 1.96 * se) < 0.6 * se,
          "width %.4f vs %.4f" % (hi - lo, 2 * 1.96 * se))
    check("T8c BCa reports no fallback on a well-behaved statistic",
          diag["fallback"] is False, str(diag))
    degenerate = np.zeros(5000)
    lo2, hi2, diag2 = P.bca_bounds(0.0, degenerate, np.zeros(80))
    check("T8d degenerate bootstrap mass triggers the declared fallback",
          diag2["fallback"] is True, str(diag2))

    n_cells = P.N_CELLS
    sc = np.full(n_cells, 1.0)
    sb = np.full(n_cells, 1.0)
    r_zero_b = P.evaluate_trial(np.full(n_cells, 4.0), np.zeros(n_cells), sc, sb, 8,
                                np.random.default_rng(5), 2000)
    check("T9 zero BSSG events give RR exactly 0 with no continuity correction",
          r_zero_b["rr"] == 0.0, str(r_zero_b["rr"]))
    check("T9b zero BSSG events still allow rule H to hold",
          r_zero_b["h"] is True)
    r_zero_c = P.evaluate_trial(np.zeros(n_cells), np.zeros(n_cells), sc, sb, 8,
                               np.random.default_rng(6), 2000)
    check("T9c zero Control events make RR not estimable",
          r_zero_c["rr_estimable"] is False)
    check("T9d and yield the declared non-estimable or guard label",
          r_zero_c["label"] in ("INCONCLUSIVE-DESIGN-VALIDITY",
                                "INCONCLUSIVE-HARM-NOT-ESTIMABLE"),
          r_zero_c["label"])
    # heavy discard share makes RR not estimable rather than silently corrected
    uc_sparse = np.zeros(n_cells)
    uc_sparse[0] = 1.0
    r_sparse = P.evaluate_trial(uc_sparse, np.zeros(n_cells), sc, sb, 8,
                                np.random.default_rng(7), 2000)
    check("T9e a large share of degenerate resamples makes RR not estimable",
          r_sparse["rr_estimable"] is False
          and r_sparse["rr_discard_share"] > P.RR_DISCARD_CAP,
          "share %.3f" % r_sparse["rr_discard_share"])


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- simulation wiring
def t13() -> None:
    src = open(P.__file__, encoding="utf-8").read()
    check("T13 the simulation never multiplies marginal powers",
          "ph * pn" not in src and "power_H\"] * " not in src)
    check("T13b joint power is taken from the label mapping",
          'r["label"] == "SUCCESS"' in src)
    check("T13c no continuity correction appears in the simulation",
          "+ 0.5" not in src and "0.5)" not in src.replace("0.5))", ""))
    check("T13d the frozen targets in code match the contract values",
          P.RD_TARGET == -0.20 and P.RR_TARGET == 0.20 and P.MARGIN == 0.05
          and P.G1_MIN_CONTROL_HARM == 0.40 and P.G2_MIN_CONTROL_SUCCESS == 0.06)
    # one short end-to-end run must produce only frozen labels
    rng = np.random.default_rng(31)
    labels = set()
    for _ in range(12):
        uc, ub, sc, sb = P.simulate_trial(rng, 8)
        labels.add(P.evaluate_trial(uc, ub, sc, sb, 8, rng, 500)["label"])
    check("T13e end-to-end labels are inside the frozen Phase B list",
          labels <= set(D.PHASE_B_LABELS), str(labels))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- guard annotations
def t14_guard_annotations() -> None:
    """T14 the two guard names are annotations, never labels (F-P3-4)."""
    strays = ("INCONCLUSIVE-CANARY-INSENSITIVE", "UNINFORMATIVE-LOW-BASE",
              "CANARY-INSENSITIVE")
    check("T14a no guard annotation name is a Phase B label",
          all(s not in D.PHASE_B_LABELS for s in strays))
    check("T14b no guard annotation name is a Phase C label",
          all(s not in D.PHASE_C_LABELS for s in strays))
    check("T14c annotation vocabulary is exactly the two frozen guards",
          set(D.GUARD_ANNOTATIONS) == {"G1", "G2"}
          and set(D.GUARD_ANNOTATIONS.values())
          == {"CANARY-INSENSITIVE", "UNINFORMATIVE-LOW-BASE"})
    check("T14d annotations are subordinate to INCONCLUSIVE-DESIGN-VALIDITY",
          D.GUARD_ANNOTATION_PARENT_LABEL == "INCONCLUSIVE-DESIGN-VALIDITY"
          and D.GUARD_ANNOTATION_PARENT_LABEL in D.PHASE_B_LABELS)
    ok = True
    for g1 in (True, False):
        for g2 in (True, False):
            ann = D.phase_b_guard_annotations(g1=g1, g2=g2)
            lab = D.phase_b_label(g1=g1, g2=g2, g3=True, h_asa=True, h_pp=True,
                                  n_asa=True, n_pp=True)
            if (g1 and g2) != (ann == ()):
                ok = False
            if ann and lab != D.GUARD_ANNOTATION_PARENT_LABEL:
                ok = False
            if any(a in D.PHASE_B_LABELS for a in ann):
                ok = False
    check("T14e every guard state yields annotations under the L2 label only", ok)
    try:
        D.phase_b_guard_annotations(g1=1, g2=True)
        check("T14f non-Boolean guard state is rejected", False)
    except D.PhaseBInputError:
        check("T14f non-Boolean guard state is rejected", True)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- route gates: no inference
def t22_no_inference_anywhere() -> None:
    """T22 the route path contains no inference of any kind (F-P4-2)."""
    check("T22a the closed route label list has exactly five descriptive labels",
          len(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS) == 5
          and set(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS) == {"OUT OF SCOPE", "FAILED", "NOT EVALUABLE",
                                            "NOT SUPPORTED", "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"},
          str(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS))
    for stray in ("SUPPORTED-INFERENTIAL", "DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY"):
        check("T22b %s is not an attainable label" % stray,
              stray not in G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS and stray in G.WITHDRAWN_LABELS)
    # identifier-level check: no inferential machinery in the executable code.
    # Prose that RECORDS the withdrawal is expected and is not searched here.
    import ast
    forbidden = ("binom", "clopper", "pearson", "pvalue", "p_value", "bh_",
                 "fdr", "null", "pi0", "significance", "attainab", "confint")
    tree = ast.parse(open(os.path.join(HERE, "shvvp_v0_5_route_gates.py"),
                          encoding="utf-8").read())
    names: set[str] = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        for attr in ("name", "id", "attr", "arg"):
            v = getattr(node, attr, None)
            if isinstance(v, str):
                names.add(v.lower())
        if isinstance(node, ast.keyword) and node.arg:
            names.add(node.arg.lower())
    hits = sorted({f for f in forbidden for n in names if f in n})
    check("T22c no identifier in the normative module is inferential machinery",
          not hits, str(hits))
    check("T22d every registry component is Class G", G.CLASS == "G"
          and all(hasattr(g, "threshold") and not hasattr(g, "pi0")
                  for g in G.REGISTRY))
    check("T22e there is no Class I and no family F3a",
          not hasattr(G, "F3A_MEMBERS") and not hasattr(G, "F3A")
          and len(G.FAMILY_F3_GATE_ONLY) == 11)
    check("T22f no evaluation function exposes a null, p-value or bound",
          not any(hasattr(G, n) for n in ("binom_sf_ge", "clopper_pearson_lower",
                                          "bh_reject", "evaluate_component",
                                          "ComponentOutcome")))
    out = G.route_claims(GOOD)
    check("T22g route output declares that no inference is performed",
          out["inference"].startswith("NONE")
          and all(v["ceiling"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"
                  for v in out["routes"].values()))
    check("T22h a supported route reports its scope limitation with its statement",
          all(v["scope_limits"] for v in out["routes"].values()
              if v["claim"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"))
    check("T22i the strongest attainable label over a perfect corpus is descriptive",
          set(v["claim"] for v in out["routes"].values())
          == {"SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"},
          str({k: v["claim"] for k, v in out["routes"].items()}))


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- route gates: raw evidence only
def t23_raw_evidence_only() -> None:
    """T23 adversarial evidence admission, executing the round 4 attacks (F-P4-1)."""
    # attack 1, the seat's own case: catastrophic raw evidence with an asserted gate
    catastrophic = dict(GOOD)
    catastrophic["R2-B"] = {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 0}
    claim = G.route_claims(catastrophic)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"]
    check("T23a 0 of 100 passing raw items cannot support a route",
          claim == "NOT SUPPORTED", claim)
    try:
        G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 0,
                                 "hard_gate_violated": False})
        check("T23b an injected hard-gate assertion is rejected", False)
    except G.RouteInputError:
        check("T23b an injected hard-gate assertion is rejected", True)
    for flag in ("evaluable", "gate_pass", "p_value", "p", "share", "_token",
                 "clusters_total", "clusters_success"):
        rec = {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 100, flag: True}
        try:
            G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", rec)
            check("T23c injected field %r is rejected" % flag, False)
        except G.RouteInputError:
            check("T23c injected field %r is rejected" % flag, True)

    # attack 2, fabricated derived object
    fabricated = G.GateResult(
        key="R2-B", route="R2", phase="B", cls="G", denominator=100, numerator=100,
        violations=0, share=1.0, min_items=50, threshold=0.98, evaluable=True,
        gate_pass=True, hard_gate_violated=False, reasons=("forged",),
        statement="forged", scope_limit="forged")
    try:
        G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R2-B": fabricated})
        check("T23d a fabricated derived object is rejected as evidence", False)
    except G.RouteInputError:
        check("T23d a fabricated derived object is rejected as evidence", True)

    # attack 3, dataclasses.replace on a genuine below-minimum report
    genuine = G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", {"denials_total": 3, "denials_typed": 3})
    check("T23e a genuine below-minimum report is not evaluable",
          genuine.evaluable is False and genuine.gate_pass is False)
    replaced = dataclasses.replace(genuine, evaluable=True, gate_pass=True,
                                   denominator=100, numerator=100, share=1.0)
    try:
        G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R2-B": replaced})
        check("T23f a dataclasses.replace forgery is rejected as evidence", False)
    except G.RouteInputError:
        check("T23f a dataclasses.replace forgery is rejected as evidence", True)
    check("T23g no token mechanism exists to forge",
          not any(hasattr(G, n) for n in ("_TOKEN", "TOKEN")))

    # below-minimum counts at n-1, n, n+1 for every component
    ok = True
    detail = []
    for g in G.REGISTRY:
        for delta in (-1, 0, 1):
            n = g.min_items + delta
            rec = {g.denominator_field: n, g.numerator_field: n}
            if g.violation_field:
                rec[g.violation_field] = 0
            r = G.evaluate_gate(g.key, rec)
            want = delta >= 0
            if r.evaluable is not want or r.gate_pass is not want:
                ok = False
                detail.append("%s n=%d" % (g.key, n))
    check("T23h every minimum evidence count is enforced at n-1, n and n+1", ok,
          ",".join(detail))

    # inconsistent raw counts
    bad = [("R2-B", {"denials_total": 10, "denials_typed": 11}),
           ("R6-B", {"receipts_adjudicated": 5, "typed_unknown": 5, "typed_clean": 9}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": -1, "denials_typed": 0}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 100.0}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": True, "denials_typed": True}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": 100}),
           ("R2-B", {}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_typed": 100}),
           ("R6-B", {"receipts_adjudicated": 30, "typed_unknown": 30}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": float("nan"), "denials_typed": 0}),
           ("R2-B", {"denials_total": None, "denials_typed": None}),
           ("NOPE", {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 100})]
    raised = 0
    for key, rec in bad:
        try:
            G.evaluate_gate(key, rec)
        except G.RouteInputError:
            raised += 1
    check("T23i all %d malformed or inconsistent records are rejected" % len(bad),
          raised == len(bad), "%d of %d" % (raised, len(bad)))

    # route_claims level rejections
    for mutate, name in (
            (lambda d: {**d, "R9-Z": {"a": 1}}, "an unknown component key"),
            (lambda d: {**d, "R2-B": "SUPPORTED"}, "a string in place of evidence"),
            (lambda d: {**d, "R2-B": [100, 100]}, "a list in place of evidence"),
            (lambda d: "everything passed", "a non-mapping input")):
        try:
            G.route_claims(mutate(dict(GOOD)))
            check("T23j route_claims rejects %s" % name, False)
        except G.RouteInputError:
            check("T23j route_claims rejects %s" % name, True)
    missing = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "R2-B"}
    check("T23k absent evidence leaves the route OUT OF SCOPE",
          G.route_claims(missing)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "OUT OF SCOPE")

    # zero-tolerance violations dominate a passing share
    for key, field in (("R6-B", "typed_clean"), ("R4-B", "widening_events"),
                       ("R5-A", "silent_overwrites"), ("R3-A",
                                                       "premature_reconciliations"),
                       ("R2-A", "branches_dropped_silently")):
        g = G.BY_KEY[key]
        rec = {g.denominator_field: g.min_items + 10,
               g.numerator_field: g.min_items + 10, field: 1}
        rec[g.numerator_field] = g.min_items + 10
        r = G.evaluate_gate(key, rec)
        claim = G.route_claims({**GOOD, key: rec})["routes"][g.route]["claim"]
        check("T23l a violation in %s.%s FAILS the route despite a perfect share"
              % (key, field),
              r.hard_gate_violated and claim == "FAILED", "%s / %s" % (r, claim))

    # conjunction only: one failing component blocks its whole route
    part = dict(GOOD)
    part["R6-C"] = {"receipts_adjudicated": 30, "typed_unknown": 28, "typed_clean": 0}
    claims = G.route_claims(part)["routes"]
    check("T23m conjunction: one component below threshold blocks the route",
          claims["R6"]["claim"] == "NOT SUPPORTED", claims["R6"]["claim"])
    check("T23n other routes are unaffected by that failure",
          claims["R2"]["claim"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")

    # exact threshold boundary behaviour
    boundary = dict(GOOD)
    boundary["R2-B"] = {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 98}
    check("T23o a share exactly at the frozen threshold is supported",
          G.route_claims(boundary)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"]
          == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")
    boundary["R2-B"] = {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 97}
    check("T23p a share one item below the frozen threshold is not supported",
          G.route_claims(boundary)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "NOT SUPPORTED")
    zero = dict(GOOD)
    zero["R2-B"] = {"denials_total": 0, "denials_typed": 0}
    check("T23q zero evidence is NOT EVALUABLE, never a pass",
          G.route_claims(zero)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "NOT EVALUABLE")


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- current-version parity
def t21_version_parity() -> None:
    """T21 every current-version reference says v0.5 (F-P4-3)."""
    def read(name):
        return open(os.path.join(HERE, name), encoding="utf-8").read()
    meta = read("DEPOSIT_METADATA_v0_5.md")
    problems = []
    if "| Version | 0.5 |" not in meta:
        problems.append("metadata version field is not 0.5")
    if "SHVVP v0.5:" not in meta and "(SHVVP) v0.5" not in meta:
        problems.append("metadata title does not state v0.5")
    if "FROZEN preregistration, version 0.5." not in meta:
        problems.append("metadata description does not open at version 0.5")
    for wrong in ("version 0.3.", "version 0.4.", "SHVVP v0.3:", "SHVVP v0.4:"):
        if wrong in meta:
            problems.append("metadata still says %r" % wrong)
    check("T21a deposit metadata states the current version everywhere", not problems,
          "; ".join(problems))

    # intended-files list must name only v0.5 current artifacts
    files_block = meta[meta.index("## 5. Files intended for the deposit record"):
                       meta.index("## 6. Pre-deposit checklist")]
    lineage_labelled = "lineage" in files_block.lower()
    stale = [tok for tok in ("both v0.3 verdicts", "both v0.4 verdicts")
             if tok in files_block]
    if not lineage_labelled:
        stale.append("earlier-version files are not labelled as lineage")
    check("T21b intended-files list names current v0.5 artifacts", not stale,
          str(stale))
    check("T21c intended-files list points at the v0.5 primary rendering",
          "SHV_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_v0_5.pdf" in files_block
          and "SHV_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_v0_5_source.md" in files_block)

    src = read("SHV_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_v0_5_source.md")
    check("T21d the canonical source states version 0.5 in the status line",
          "FROZEN preregistration, version 0.5." in src)
    check("T21e the README states v0.5 as the artifact",
          "(SHVVP) v0.5" in read("README.md"))
    check("T21f the dispatch brief is a v0.5 brief",
          "SHVVP v0.5" in read("SHVVP_v0_5_AUDIT_DISPATCH_BRIEF.md"))
    check("T21g the focused-delta addendum is a v0.5 addendum",
          "v0.5" in read("SHVVP_v0_5_FOCUSED_DELTA_ADDENDUM.md"))
    if shutil.which("pdfinfo"):
        out = subprocess.run(["pdfinfo", os.path.join(
            HERE, "SHV_VALIDATION_PROTOCOL_v0_5.pdf")], capture_output=True,
            text=True).stdout
        check("T21h the PDF metadata states v0.5 in Title and Subject",
              "v0.5" in out and "version 0.5" in out,
              [l for l in out.split("\n") if l.startswith(("Title", "Subject"))][:1])
    else:
        check("T21h pdfinfo available for PDF parity", False, "pdfinfo absent")
    check("T21i historical references to earlier versions are retained",
          all(v in src for v in ("v0.1", "v0.2", "v0.3", "v0.4")))
    check("T21j all four earlier versions are stated HALTED",
          "All four earlier versions are HALTED" in src)

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- Phase C fuzzing
def t17_phase_c_validation() -> None:
    """T17 Phase C rejects or fail-closes every invalid input (F-P3-3)."""
    def state(**over):
        st = {"conjunct_fail": {c: False for c in D.CONJUNCTS},
              "unknown_share": {c: 0.0 for c in D.CONJUNCTS},
              "alpha_c1": 0.90, "alpha_c3": 0.90, "cap_check_pass": True,
              "m10_events": 0, "m11_events": 0}
        st.update(over)
        return st

    nan, inf, ninf = float("nan"), float("inf"), float("-inf")
    bad_alphas = (nan, inf, ninf, None, -0.1, 1.1, 2.0, -1e9)
    ok = True
    for a in bad_alphas:
        r = D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=a))
        if r["label"] != "INDETERMINATE-ADJUDICATION" or r["alpha_defined"]:
            ok = False
    check("T17a an undefined or out-of-range alpha yields "
          "INDETERMINATE-ADJUDICATION, never a pass", ok)

    ok = True
    for a in bad_alphas:
        cf = {c: False for c in D.CONJUNCTS}
        cf["C1"] = True
        r = D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=a, conjunct_fail=cf))
        if r["label"] == "PASS-ALL-SIX" or "C1" in r["hard_failures"]:
            ok = False
    check("T17b failed C1 with an undefined alpha can never PASS and cannot "
          "count as a hard failure", ok)

    ok = True
    for a in bad_alphas:
        cf = {c: False for c in D.CONJUNCTS}
        cf["C2"] = True                     # mechanical failure dominates
        r = D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=a, conjunct_fail=cf))
        if r["label"] != "FAIL":
            ok = False
    check("T17c a mechanical failure still dominates an undefined alpha", ok)

    ok = True
    for s in (nan, inf, ninf, None, -0.5, 1.5):
        us = {c: 0.0 for c in D.CONJUNCTS}
        us["C4"] = s
        r = D.phase_c_label(**state(unknown_share=us))
        if r["label"] != "INCONCLUSIVE-UNKNOWN-DOMINATED" or "C4" not in \
                r["unknown_dominated_conjuncts"]:
            ok = False
    check("T17d an undefined UNKNOWN share is treated as exceeding the cap", ok)

    structural = [
        state(conjunct_fail={c: 0 for c in D.CONJUNCTS}),
        state(conjunct_fail={c: None for c in D.CONJUNCTS}),
        state(conjunct_fail={c: "no" for c in D.CONJUNCTS}),
        state(conjunct_fail={"C1": False}),
        state(unknown_share={"C1": 0.0}),
        state(conjunct_fail=[False] * 6),
        state(unknown_share={c: "0" for c in D.CONJUNCTS}),
        state(cap_check_pass=1),
        state(cap_check_pass=None),
        state(m10_events=-1),
        state(m10_events=nan),
        state(m11_events=0.5),
        state(m11_events=True),
        state(alpha_c1="0.9"),
        state(alpha_c3=True),
    ]
    raised = 0
    for st in structural:
        try:
            D.phase_c_label(**st)
        except D.PhaseCInputError:
            raised += 1
    check("T17e all %d structurally malformed Phase C inputs are rejected"
          % len(structural), raised == len(structural),
          "%d of %d" % (raised, len(structural)))

    # totality over an invalid and non-finite domain: never PASS, never crash
    # other than by PhaseCInputError
    weird = (nan, inf, ninf, None, -0.1, 1.1, 0.0, 0.5, 0.7, 0.8, 1.0)
    labels, passes = set(), 0
    for a1 in weird:
        for a3 in weird:
            for u in weird:
                for c1fail in (True, False):
                    cf = {c: False for c in D.CONJUNCTS}
                    cf["C1"] = c1fail
                    us = {c: 0.0 for c in D.CONJUNCTS}
                    us["C1"] = u
                    try:
                        r = D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=a1, alpha_c3=a3,
                                                    conjunct_fail=cf,
                                                    unknown_share=us))
                    except D.PhaseCInputError:
                        continue
                    labels.add(r["label"])
                    if r["label"] == "PASS-ALL-SIX":
                        passes += 1
                        if not (isinstance(a1, float) and isinstance(a3, float)
                                and a1 >= D.ALPHA_PASS and a3 >= D.ALPHA_PASS
                                and not c1fail
                                and isinstance(u, float) and 0.0 <= u
                                <= D.UNKNOWN_CAP):
                            check("T17f a pass appeared on invalid input", False,
                                  "a1=%r a3=%r u=%r c1fail=%r" % (a1, a3, u, c1fail))
    check("T17f every pass over the invalid and non-finite domain is justified",
          passes > 0)
    check("T17g the fuzzed domain stays inside the closed Phase C label list",
          labels <= set(D.PHASE_C_LABELS), str(labels))
    check("T17h a pass requires defined reliability",
          all(D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=a))["label"] != "PASS-ALL-SIX"
              for a in bad_alphas))
    check("T17i novelty admissibility rejects an undefined-alpha result",
          not D.phase_c_novelty_admissible(D.phase_c_label(**state(alpha_c1=nan))))


def main() -> None:
    t1_t2_t3_t4()
    t5_t6_t7()
    t8_t9()
    t13()
    t14_guard_annotations()
    t17_phase_c_validation()
    t19_no_stale_design_size()
    t21_version_parity()
    t22_no_inference_anywhere()
    t23_raw_evidence_only()
    t24_simulation_carried()
    print("\n%d checks failed" % len(FAILURES))
    if FAILURES:
        print("failed: %s" % FAILURES)
    sys.exit(1 if FAILURES else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

## R0389 · test_shvvp_v0_6_rules.py — Route-gate test suite for the frozen SHVVP v0.6 protocol.

- section: V. BSSG & SHVVP Protocols
- source_file: test_shvvp_v0_6_rules.py
- source_format: py
- text_sha256: 71137f09be15901d26ea9749bb9684acb50900b6173f7ed57916d9e479bbaf20

"""Route-gate test suite for the frozen SHVVP v0.6 protocol.

Scope. v0.6 changes exactly one executable module relative to v0.5, the route
gate, to close the blocking finding F-P5-1 (caller-selectable evidence universe
and post-result omission). This suite therefore focuses on the route gate: it
carries forward the v0.5 no-inference and raw-evidence-only tests, adapted to the
v0.6 scope-binding record schema, and ADDS named adversarial regression tests that
reproduce each of the three F-P5-1 attacks and assert the corrected outcome. The
decision-rules, power-simulation and verifier suites are unchanged from v0.5 and
are carried in the release packet as lineage.

Run: `python3 test_shvvp_v0_6_rules.py` -> exits non-zero if any check fails.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import ast
import dataclasses
import os

import shvvp_v0_6_route_gates as G

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
FAILURES: list[str] = []
COUNT = 0


def check(name: str, cond: bool, detail: str = "") -> None:
    global COUNT
    COUNT += 1
    if cond:
        print("PASS  %s" % name)
    else:
        print("FAIL  %s%s" % (name, ("  [%s]" % detail) if detail else ""))
        FAILURES.append(name)


# --------------------------------------------------------------- record binding
def bound(key: str, **counts) -> dict:
    """Build a v0.6-valid raw-evidence record: the frozen counts plus the manifest
    and committed-universe binding. For a sealed or realized universe the committed
    cardinality defaults to the submitted denominator (a complete submission);
    tests that probe subsets pass an explicit `sealed_universe_n` / `realized_total`
    or a `reconciliation`."""
    entry = G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY[key]
    spec = G.BY_KEY[key]
    rec = dict(counts)
    rec.setdefault("manifest_sha256", G.MANIFEST_SHA256)
    rec.setdefault("universe_id", entry.universe_id)
    denom = counts.get(spec.denominator_field)
    if entry.kind == G.KIND_SEALED:
        if "sealed_universe_n" not in rec:
            rec["sealed_universe_n"] = denom
        rec.setdefault("sealed_universe_hash", "sealed:%s:committed" % key)
    elif entry.kind == G.KIND_REALIZED:
        if "realized_total" not in rec:
            rec["realized_total"] = denom
        rec.setdefault("run_log_hash", "runlog:%s:committed" % key)
    return rec


# The canonical perfect corpus, every record bound and complete against its
# committed universe. Note R4-C is now the full 216-injection universe (was a
# 40-item subset under v0.5), and every record carries its manifest binding.
GOOD = {
    "R1-A": bound("R1-A", facts_examined=10, facts_incremental=10),
    "R2-A": bound("R2-A", branches_planted=16, branches_typed=14,
                  branches_dropped_silently=0),
    "R2-B": bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100),
    "R3-A": bound("R3-A", conflicts_planted=12, conflicts_preserved=12,
                  premature_reconciliations=0),
    "R4-B": bound("R4-B", injections_total=60, injections_narrowed=60,
                  widening_events=0),
    "R4-C": bound("R4-C", injections_total=216, injections_narrowed=216,
                  widening_events=0),
    "R5-A": bound("R5-A", descendants_recorded=25, descendants_reached=25,
                  silent_overwrites=0),
    "R5-C": bound("R5-C", descendants_recorded=6, descendants_reached=6,
                  silent_overwrites=0),
    "R6-A": bound("R6-A", absent_items=60, typed_unknown=60, typed_clean=0),
    "R6-B": bound("R6-B", receipts_adjudicated=35, typed_unknown=35, typed_clean=0),
    "R6-C": bound("R6-C", receipts_adjudicated=30, typed_unknown=30, typed_clean=0),
}


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- no inference
def t22_no_inference_anywhere() -> None:
    """T22 the route path contains no inference of any kind (carried, F-P4-2)."""
    check("T22a the closed route label list has exactly six descriptive labels",
          len(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS) == 6
          and set(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS) == {"OUT OF SCOPE", "INCOMPLETE", "FAILED",
                                            "NOT EVALUABLE", "NOT SUPPORTED",
                                            "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"},
          str(G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS))
    for stray in ("SUPPORTED-INFERENTIAL", "DESCRIPTIVE-ONLY"):
        check("T22b %s is not an attainable label" % stray,
              stray not in G.ROUTE_CLAIM_LABELS and stray in G.WITHDRAWN_LABELS)
    forbidden = ("binom", "clopper", "pearson", "pvalue", "p_value", "bh_",
                 "fdr", "pi0", "significance", "attainab", "confint")
    tree = ast.parse(open(os.path.join(HERE, "shvvp_v0_6_route_gates.py"),
                          encoding="utf-8").read())
    names: set[str] = set()
    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        for attr in ("name", "id", "attr", "arg"):
            v = getattr(node, attr, None)
            if isinstance(v, str):
                names.add(v.lower())
        if isinstance(node, ast.keyword) and node.arg:
            names.add(node.arg.lower())
    hits = sorted({f for f in forbidden for n in names if f in n})
    check("T22c no identifier in the normative module is inferential machinery",
          not hits, str(hits))
    check("T22d every registry component is Class G", G.CLASS == "G"
          and all(hasattr(g, "threshold") and not hasattr(g, "pi0")
                  for g in G.REGISTRY))
    check("T22e there is no Class I and no family F3a",
          not hasattr(G, "F3A_MEMBERS") and not hasattr(G, "F3A")
          and len(G.FAMILY_F3_GATE_ONLY) == 11)
    out = G.route_claims(GOOD)
    check("T22f route output declares that no inference is performed",
          out["inference"].startswith("NONE")
          and all(v["ceiling"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"
                  for v in out["routes"].values()))
    check("T22g the strongest attainable label over a perfect corpus is descriptive",
          set(v["claim"] for v in out["routes"].values())
          == {"SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE"},
          str({k: v["claim"] for k, v in out["routes"].items()}))


# ---------------------------------------------------------- raw evidence only
def t23_raw_evidence_only() -> None:
    """T23 adversarial evidence admission, carried from v0.5 (F-P4-1), on the v0.6
    binding schema."""
    # a catastrophic but well-bound record cannot support a route.
    catastrophic = dict(GOOD)
    catastrophic["R2-B"] = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=0)
    claim = G.route_claims(catastrophic)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"]
    check("T23a 0 of 100 passing raw items cannot support a route",
          claim == "NOT SUPPORTED", claim)

    # an injected decision field is rejected as an unexpected field.
    for flag in ("evaluable", "gate_pass", "p_value", "share", "_token",
                 "hard_gate_violated", "clusters_total"):
        rec = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100)
        rec[flag] = True
        try:
            G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", rec)
            check("T23b injected field %r is rejected" % flag, False)
        except G.RouteInputError:
            check("T23b injected field %r is rejected" % flag, True)

    # a fabricated derived object is rejected as evidence.
    fabricated = G.GateResult(
        key="R2-B", route="R2", phase="B", cls="G", denominator=100, numerator=100,
        violations=0, share=1.0, min_items=50, threshold=0.98, evaluable=True,
        gate_pass=True, hard_gate_violated=False, universe_n=100, reasons=("forged",),
        statement="forged", scope_limit="forged")
    try:
        G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R2-B": fabricated})
        check("T23c a fabricated derived object is rejected as evidence", False)
    except G.RouteInputError:
        check("T23c a fabricated derived object is rejected as evidence", True)

    # dataclasses.replace on a genuine below-minimum report is rejected.
    genuine = G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", bound("R2-B", denials_total=3, denials_typed=3))
    check("T23d a genuine below-minimum report is not evaluable",
          genuine.evaluable is False and genuine.gate_pass is False)
    replaced = dataclasses.replace(genuine, evaluable=True, gate_pass=True,
                                   denominator=100, numerator=100, share=1.0)
    try:
        G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R2-B": replaced})
        check("T23e a dataclasses.replace forgery is rejected as evidence", False)
    except G.RouteInputError:
        check("T23e a dataclasses.replace forgery is rejected as evidence", True)
    check("T23f no token mechanism exists to forge",
          not any(hasattr(G, n) for n in ("_TOKEN", "TOKEN")))

    # minimum evidence counts enforced at n-1, n, n+1 (realized components, where a
    # subset below the committed universe is not itself the point).
    ok, detail = True, []
    for key in ("R2-B", "R4-B", "R6-B", "R6-C"):
        g = G.BY_KEY[key]
        for delta in (-1, 0, 1):
            n = g.min_items + delta
            rec = bound(key, **{g.denominator_field: n, g.numerator_field: n,
                                **({g.violation_field: 0} if g.violation_field
                                   else {})})
            r = G.evaluate_gate(key, rec)
            want = delta >= 0
            if r.evaluable is not want or r.gate_pass is not want:
                ok = False
                detail.append("%s n=%d" % (key, n))
    check("T23g realized minimum evidence counts enforced at n-1, n and n+1", ok,
          ",".join(detail))

    # malformed or inconsistent records are rejected.
    bad = [
        ("R2-B", bound("R2-B", denials_total=10, denials_typed=11)),
        ("R6-B", bound("R6-B", receipts_adjudicated=5, typed_unknown=5,
                       typed_clean=9)),
        ("R2-B", bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100.0)),
        ("R2-B", {**bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100),
                  "denials_total": True}),
        ("R2-B", {k: v for k, v in bound("R2-B", denials_total=100,
                                         denials_typed=100).items()
                  if k != "denials_typed"}),
        ("NOPE", {"denials_total": 100, "denials_typed": 100}),
    ]
    raised = sum(1 for key, rec in bad
                 if _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate(key, rec)))
    check("T23h all %d malformed or inconsistent records are rejected" % len(bad),
          raised == len(bad), "%d of %d" % (raised, len(bad)))

    # route_claims level rejections.
    for mutate, name in (
            (lambda d: {**d, "R9-Z": {"a": 1}}, "an unknown component key"),
            (lambda d: {**d, "R2-B": "SUPPORTED"}, "a string in place of evidence"),
            (lambda d: {**d, "R2-B": [100, 100]}, "a list in place of evidence"),
            (lambda d: "everything passed", "a non-mapping input")):
        check("T23i route_claims rejects %s" % name,
              _raises(lambda: G.route_claims(mutate(dict(GOOD)))))

    # zero-tolerance violations dominate a passing share.
    for key, field in (("R6-B", "typed_clean"), ("R4-B", "widening_events"),
                       ("R5-A", "silent_overwrites"),
                       ("R2-A", "branches_dropped_silently")):
        g = G.BY_KEY[key]
        n = g.min_items + 10 if G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY[key].kind != G.KIND_FIXED \
            else G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY[key].universe_n
        rec = bound(key, **{g.denominator_field: n, g.numerator_field: n, field: 1})
        r = G.evaluate_gate(key, rec)
        claim = G.route_claims({**GOOD, key: rec})["routes"][g.route]["claim"]
        check("T23j a violation in %s.%s FAILS the route despite a perfect share"
              % (key, field), r.hard_gate_violated and claim == "FAILED",
              "%s / %s" % (r.hard_gate_violated, claim))

    # conjunction only: one failing component blocks its whole route.
    part = dict(GOOD)
    part["R6-C"] = bound("R6-C", receipts_adjudicated=30, typed_unknown=28,
                         typed_clean=0)
    claims = G.route_claims(part)["routes"]
    check("T23k conjunction: one component below threshold blocks the route",
          claims["R6"]["claim"] == "NOT SUPPORTED", claims["R6"]["claim"])
    check("T23l other routes are unaffected by that failure",
          claims["R2"]["claim"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")

    # exact threshold boundary behaviour (realized component, denominator == 100).
    boundary = dict(GOOD)
    boundary["R2-B"] = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=98)
    check("T23m a share exactly at the frozen threshold is supported",
          G.route_claims(boundary)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"]
          == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")
    boundary["R2-B"] = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=97)
    check("T23n a share one item below the frozen threshold is not supported",
          G.route_claims(boundary)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "NOT SUPPORTED")
    zero = dict(GOOD)
    zero["R2-B"] = bound("R2-B", denials_total=0, denials_typed=0)
    check("T23o zero evidence is NOT EVALUABLE, never a pass",
          G.route_claims(zero)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "NOT EVALUABLE")


# ---------------------------------------------- F-P5-1 adversarial regressions
def tp51a_fixed_denominator_subset() -> None:
    """F-P5-1 attack (a): a favorable subset satisfies a fixed-denominator route.
    Section 7.2 fixes Phase C at 216 injections; v0.5 accepted R4-C 30/30. v0.6
    requires equality or an explicit, fail-closed reconciliation."""
    # the exact v0.5-accepted submission is now rejected outright.
    subset = bound("R4-C", injections_total=30, injections_narrowed=30,
                   widening_events=0)
    check("TP51a-1 R4-C 30/30 subset of the 216 universe is rejected at the gate",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R4-C", subset)))
    check("TP51a-2 the same subset is rejected inside route_claims",
          _raises(lambda: G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R4-C": subset})))
    # a reconciliation cannot inflate: the 186 shortfall is scored as non-passing.
    recon = {"universe_n": 216,
             "excluded": [{"count": 186, "reason": "not run in this pass"}]}
    r = G.evaluate_gate("R4-C", bound("R4-C", injections_total=30,
                                      injections_narrowed=30, widening_events=0,
                                      reconciliation=recon))
    check("TP51a-3 a reconciled 30/30 is scored over the full 216 and does not pass",
          r.denominator == 216 and r.numerator == 30 and abs(r.share - 30 / 216)
          < 1e-9 and r.gate_pass is False, "%d/%d share=%.4f pass=%s"
          % (r.numerator, r.denominator, r.share, r.gate_pass))
    # a reconciliation whose arithmetic does not close is rejected.
    bad_recon = {"universe_n": 216,
                 "excluded": [{"count": 10, "reason": "short"}]}
    check("TP51a-4 a reconciliation that does not account for the full shortfall is "
          "rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R4-C", bound(
              "R4-C", injections_total=30, injections_narrowed=30,
              widening_events=0, reconciliation=bad_recon))))
    # the full committed universe passes.
    full = bound("R4-C", injections_total=216, injections_narrowed=216,
                 widening_events=0)
    check("TP51a-5 the full 216-injection universe is admissible and supports R4-C",
          G.route_claims({**GOOD, "R4-C": full})["routes"]["R4"]["claim"]
          == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")
    # a denominator ABOVE the committed universe is rejected (no enlargement).
    check("TP51a-6 a denominator above the committed 216 universe is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R4-C", bound(
              "R4-C", injections_total=217, injections_narrowed=217,
              widening_events=0))))


def tp51b_sealed_universe_subset() -> None:
    """F-P5-1 attack (b): a sealed descendant universe is reduced to a favorable
    sample. v0.5 accepted R5-A 20/20 and R5-C 6/6 with no cardinality binding."""
    # a submission of 20 against a sealed universe of 25, without reconciliation.
    subset = bound("R5-A", descendants_recorded=20, descendants_reached=20,
                   silent_overwrites=0, sealed_universe_n=25,
                   sealed_universe_hash="seal-25")
    check("TP51b-1 an R5-A 20-of-25 sealed subset is rejected without reconciliation",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R5-A", subset)))
    # a sealed record with no sealed cardinality/hash binding is rejected.
    unbound_seal = {k: v for k, v in bound(
        "R5-A", descendants_recorded=20, descendants_reached=20,
        silent_overwrites=0).items() if k != "sealed_universe_hash"}
    check("TP51b-2 a sealed record missing its sealed_universe_hash is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R5-A", unbound_seal)))
    # the full sealed universe is admissible and supports the route.
    check("TP51b-3 the full sealed descendant universe supports R5",
          G.route_claims(GOOD)["routes"]["R5"]["claim"]
          == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")
    # a reconciled sealed shortfall is scored over the sealed cardinality.
    recon = {"universe_n": 25,
             "excluded": [{"count": 5, "reason": "descendant not yet corrected"}]}
    r = G.evaluate_gate("R5-A", bound(
        "R5-A", descendants_recorded=20, descendants_reached=20, silent_overwrites=0,
        sealed_universe_n=25, sealed_universe_hash="seal-25", reconciliation=recon))
    check("TP51b-4 a reconciled sealed shortfall is scored over the sealed universe",
          r.denominator == 25 and abs(r.share - 20 / 25) < 1e-9
          and r.gate_pass is False, "%d/%d pass=%s"
          % (r.numerator, r.denominator, r.gate_pass))


def tp51c_omission_is_not_out_of_scope() -> None:
    """F-P5-1 attack (c): an unfavorable committed component is deleted to convert
    NOT SUPPORTED into OUT OF SCOPE. v0.5 shipped test T23k blessing this."""
    # present unfavorable -> NOT SUPPORTED.
    present_bad = dict(GOOD)
    present_bad["R2-B"] = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=0)
    check("TP51c-1 R2 with R2-B 0/100 present is NOT SUPPORTED",
          G.route_claims(present_bad)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "NOT SUPPORTED")
    # delete the unfavorable committed component -> INCOMPLETE, never OUT OF SCOPE.
    deleted = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "R2-B"}
    r2 = G.route_claims(deleted)["routes"]["R2"]
    check("TP51c-2 deleting the committed R2-B yields INCOMPLETE, not OUT OF SCOPE",
          r2["claim"] == "INCOMPLETE" and "R2-B" in r2["missing_committed"],
          r2["claim"])
    check("TP51c-3 the v0.5 omission escape (absence -> OUT OF SCOPE) is closed",
          G.route_claims(deleted)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] != "OUT OF SCOPE")
    # a present OBSERVED failure is reported as such even if another committed
    # component is also missing: an observed failure is not masked as INCOMPLETE.
    both = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "R2-B"}
    both["R2-A"] = bound("R2-A", branches_planted=16, branches_typed=16,
                         branches_dropped_silently=3)
    check("TP51c-4 an observed FAILED dominates a co-occurring missing component",
          G.route_claims(both)["routes"]["R2"]["claim"] == "FAILED")
    # the ONE legitimate predeclared exclusion (R3, no instrumentation) is distinct.
    no_r3 = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "R3-A"}
    check("TP51c-5 R3 with no instrumentation record is validly OUT OF SCOPE",
          G.route_claims(no_r3)["routes"]["R3"]["claim"] == "OUT OF SCOPE")
    check("TP51c-6 R3 with an instrumentation record is evaluated, not excused",
          G.route_claims(GOOD)["routes"]["R3"]["claim"] == "SUPPORTED-DESCRIPTIVE")
    # deleting a committed component from a MULTI-phase route is INCOMPLETE too.
    del_r4c = {k: v for k, v in GOOD.items() if k != "R4-C"}
    check("TP51c-7 deleting committed R4-C yields INCOMPLETE for R4, not OUT OF SCOPE",
          G.route_claims(del_r4c)["routes"]["R4"]["claim"] == "INCOMPLETE")


def tp51d_manifest_binding() -> None:
    """F-P5-1 disposition items 1-2: every record is bound to the frozen pre-results
    scope manifest and to its committed universe identifier."""
    check("TP51d-1 the scope manifest digest is stable and reproducible",
          isinstance(G.MANIFEST_SHA256, str) and len(G.MANIFEST_SHA256) == 64
          and G.MANIFEST_SHA256
          == __import__("hashlib").sha256(
              G._manifest_canonical().encode("utf-8")).hexdigest())
    check("TP51d-2 the manifest and registry cover the same eleven components",
          set(G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY) == set(G.BY_KEY) and len(G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY) == 11)
    check("TP51d-3 exactly one component is predeclared conditionally out of scope",
          [e.key for e in G.SCOPE_MANIFEST
           if e.status == G.STATUS_PREDECLARED_CONDITIONAL_OOS] == ["R3-A"])
    # a wrong manifest hash is rejected.
    wrong_m = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100)
    wrong_m["manifest_sha256"] = "0" * 64
    check("TP51d-4 a record bound to the wrong manifest digest is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", wrong_m)))
    # a missing manifest hash is rejected.
    no_m = {k: v for k, v in bound("R2-B", denials_total=100,
                                   denials_typed=100).items()
            if k != "manifest_sha256"}
    check("TP51d-5 a record with no manifest binding is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", no_m)))
    # a wrong universe identifier is rejected.
    wrong_u = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100)
    wrong_u["universe_id"] = "u.someone-elses-universe"
    check("TP51d-6 a record bound to the wrong universe identifier is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", wrong_u)))
    # the R4-C committed cardinality is 216 in both the manifest and the registry.
    check("TP51d-7 R4-C committed universe is 216 (was a 30-item floor in v0.5)",
          G.MANIFEST_BY_KEY["R4-C"].universe_n == 216
          and G.BY_KEY["R4-C"].min_items == 216)


def tp51e_realized_run_log_binding() -> None:
    """F-P5-1 disposition item 2 for realized universes: a count not knowable before
    the run (Section 0.1 A-3.7) is bound to a pre-committed run log and its realized
    total, and the denominator must equal that total."""
    # a realized record with no run-log binding is rejected.
    no_runlog = {k: v for k, v in bound("R2-B", denials_total=100,
                                        denials_typed=100).items()
                 if k != "run_log_hash"}
    check("TP51e-1 a realized record missing its run_log_hash is rejected",
          _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", no_runlog)))
    # a realized_total that disagrees with the denominator is rejected.
    mismatch = bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100)
    mismatch["realized_total"] = 120
    check("TP51e-2 a realized_total above the denominator (undeclared shortfall) is "
          "rejected", _raises(lambda: G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", mismatch)))
    # a matched realized submission is admissible.
    r = G.evaluate_gate("R2-B", bound("R2-B", denials_total=100, denials_typed=100))
    check("TP51e-3 a run-log-bound realized submission is admissible",
          r.evaluable and r.gate_pass and r.universe_n == 100)


def _raises(fn) -> bool:
    try:
        fn()
        return False
    except G.RouteInputError:
        return True


def main() -> None:
    t22_no_inference_anywhere()
    t23_raw_evidence_only()
    tp51a_fixed_denominator_subset()
    tp51b_sealed_universe_subset()
    tp51c_omission_is_not_out_of_scope()
    tp51d_manifest_binding()
    tp51e_realized_run_log_binding()
    print("\n%d checks, %d failures" % (COUNT, len(FAILURES)))
    if FAILURES:
        for name in FAILURES:
            print("  FAILED: %s" % name)
    raise SystemExit(1 if FAILURES else 0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
